title: hat utilits
description: This plugin allows you to put any object on your head.
body:
# ![Demonstration](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2bb335a3d752a6d349c535dfd91fcea859ef4bbd.png) 

This plugin allows you to equip any object on your head.

Hold the object in your hand and type **/hat**

You can configure permissions for the command at **../plugins/hat/config.yml**

Example config:

  **Permissions_required: false** (default) - When false, the command does not require permissions.
